question: A transformer is used to step up voltage for transmission of electric power. Explain why this reduces power loss in transmission lines. Give reason.

options.A: For fixed power, stepping up voltage increases line current, so $I^2R$ loss increases.
options.B: A transformer reduces power loss by increasing the resistance of the line.
options.C: Power loss is reduced because a step-up transformer produces direct current in the line.
options.D: For the same transmitted power, $P=VI$ shows that increasing $V$ reduces $I$. Since line loss is $P_{\text{loss}}=I^2R$, the loss decreases greatly.
